d:
The return of severe air pollution after Deepavali has reignited debate over the effectiveness of green crackers, firecracker regulations and public health protections.
Despite restrictions and the promotion of low-emission crackers, air quality across several North Indian cities deteriorated sharply following Deepavali celebrations. The episode has once again raised questions about enforcement, environmental policy and the balance between cultural practices and public health concerns.
Thank you for watching our video!
